text:
3 saal sarkari exam ki taiyari ki. Paper leak ho gaya.

Exam cancel. Phir COVID aaya, aur lagbhag 2 saal koi kaam nahi tha.

Main Charkhi Dadri ke ek gaon se hoon. Sarkari, Hindi medium school, jismein ek computer bhi nahi tha. Pehla laptop 2020 mein aaya.

Uske baad 4 saal freelance editing. Brand ads, TV commercials, fashion shoots, 20+ brands. STAGE meri pehli corporate job hai.

"AI" shabd pehli baar 2022 mein suna. 2024 tak free aur open-source models pe video, audio, text sab try kar raha tha. Aaj STAGE pe Jai Hanuman banata hoon, ek AI animated series, 6 boliyon mein.

Beech ka jump talent se nahi aaya. Do aadaton se aaya:

Har naya tool usi hafte try kiya, real kaam pe, demo pe nahi.
Editor ki tarah sochna kabhi nahi chhoda. AI shots de deta hai. Kaunse 3 second kaam ke hain, yeh abhi bhi editor decide karta hai.

Jo gaon se yeh padh raha hai: tools ab almost free hain. Taste download nahi hota, kaam karke banta hai.

Aapka turning point kya tha?
media_brief: Photo post: your first laptop or an early editing setup next to a current Jai Hanuman frame. A plain text post also works.
